verdict.rationale: Maritime documents a RESTful API and a CLI with stable exit codes and a self-describing contract. However, nothing in the evidence mentions API version identifiers, version pinning, or a deprecation or sunset policy. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no published versioned spec. Because API versioning is a fair question for a cloud platform with a public API, this is "none" rather than "na".
